props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called after the browser or a part opened or closed it. A press outside and Escape can't be refused: a controlled menu that keeps `open` true is shown again.

parts.name: MenuTrigger
parts.description: Spread on a <button>. `popovertarget` is there so the browser doesn't count a press on the trigger as a press outside the open menu; the click itself is the menu's (it is prevented, so the browser doesn't toggle), which lets a menubar keep a menu open that hovering opened.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present on the trigger while its popup is open.

parts.name: MenuPopup
parts.description: The menu: a `popover="auto"` element placed against its trigger. A submenu's popup is declared inside the parent's popup, which is what makes the browser treat it as nested.

props.name: side
props.default: "bottom"; "right" for a submenu and in a vertical menubar
props.description: Which side of the trigger it sits on; the browser flips it when it doesn't fit.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger it lines up with.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between trigger and popup, in pixels.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of its anchor the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether choosing the item closes the menu (and every menu it is nested in).

parts.name: MenuLinkItem
parts.description: A menu item that is a link: Enter follows it.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether following the link closes the menu.

parts.name: MenuSubmenuRoot
parts.description: A menu inside a menu: holds a MenuSubmenuTrigger (an item of the parent) and the submenu's own MenuPopup, declared inside the parent's MenuPopup. The parts beneath it read it as `menu`, like a top-level menu.

parts.name: MenuSubmenuTrigger
parts.description: An item of the parent menu that opens the submenu: on hover (the pointer may cross other items on its way to the submenu without closing it), on click, and on ArrowRight, Enter and Space, which also move focus into it. Spread it on a <button>: like MenuTrigger, its `popovertarget` keeps a press on it from closing the submenu (a press on any other part of the parent menu does close it), and the click itself is prevented.

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Whether resting the pointer on the trigger opens the submenu.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long the pointer rests on the trigger before the submenu opens, in ms.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long after the pointer leaves (and not towards the submenu) before it closes, in ms.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present on the trigger while its popup is open.

parts.name: MenuArrow
parts.description: Spread on an element inside the popup: it is placed on the popup's edge that faces the trigger, centred on the trigger, and carries the popup's `data-side`. The shape (a rotated square, an SVG) is the stylesheet's.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of its anchor the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.
